what: A full Ebon Hawk run: kills (hostile creatures and active encounters of each module), then the quest XP met in that module, in module order. Written by tools/xp/make_path.py; read by tools/xp/calc.py --scenario.
assumptions: Every creature data/xp/k1-enemies.json marks hostile is killed; creatures a script may turn hostile (hostile = maybe) are left out; creatures whose template cannot die (Plot, Min1HP) are left out.
Active encounters spawn as calc.py replays the engine's spawn list for a party of three (mean of 200 seeded runs); encounters that respawn are counted once.
Only the chapter's own quests (build.py PLANETS tag_prefix) count; a quest of another chapter that this chapter's files also set is counted by its own chapter.

Each quest follows one route to one ending (the lowest ending stage the quest database reaches unless make_path.py ENDINGS names another); a stage gives its journal XP and the largest XP of one of its steps.
Not counted: plot XP on dialog lines that set no journal stage, level-scaled computer and repair XP, stealth XP.
k_jagi stage 20: journal XP 1500 with no module; left out
